family.name: Family gym
family.about: Everyone knows everyone. The older fighters keep the kids in line, and nobody skips without someone asking why.

hard_sparring.name: Hard sparring
hard_sparring.about: Thursday sparring is a war. You learn fast here, or you get hurt.

party.name: Party gym
party.about: Great people, loud music and a bar across the road. Training's good when everyone turns up.
